messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — hosted-api queue length 12,200 (5m avg). p95=3.2s p99=9.8s. us-west GPU pool util 96% (12/13 nodes). Autoscaler errors: \"quota-exceeded\" 10x. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-queue-spike

sre-jordan: I'm paged, on the bridge. Starting quick triage: which tenants are spiking? logs + pods + autoscaler errors coming up.

maria-ops: confirming visible error from provisioner: 429 responses from cloud quota API. Provisioner is retrying/backoff. Also seeing VCPU quota warnings for new instance types.

ajay-ml: possible immediate mitigation — spin up a trimmed model variant (quantized 4-bit) in eu-west and enable cross-region fallback. I can push the variant in ~6m.

eng-tomas: we can also flip model-routing to prefer cheaper smaller model for non-SLAd routes. Doing feature-flag toggle (safe toggle). Who owns the FF?

sre-jordan: @eng-tomas please create the toggle and post the curl command here. I'll coordinate routing change once we have it.

eng-tomas: curl -X POST https://flags.redwood/api/toggles/model-routing -d '{"route":"non-sla","preferred":"small-quant"}' - confirmed minimal rollout.

maria-ops: support flagged top 5 customers affected (by request volume): acme-corp, beta-io, shopperly, analytics-labs, jugger. support-lina is contacting them with status.

support-lina: contacting customers now, sending 15m ETA and suggested retry/backoff. Will escalate if any high-priority SLA is at risk.

ajay-ml: spun up quantized variant in eu-west. Confirming health: /health OK. Will push model alias so routing can fall back.

sre-jordan: good. I'm enabling cross-region fallback for non-SLA traffic now. Command: /infra route enable-fallback --from us-west --to eu-west --filter non-sla.

ops-bot: ACTIONLOG created by sre-jordan: enabled cross-region fallback for non-sla routes. Autoscaler queue length decreasing from 12,200 -> 8,900 in last 4m.

maria-ops: still seeing provisioning 429s when trying to add capacity in us-west. Quota request to cloud team already submitted (ticket #CLD-8421).

eng-tomas: toggled model-routing flag. Monitoring for error regressions. :thumbsup:

ajay-ml: quantized variant token cost is ~40% lower and reduces GPU memory pressure — should relieve hot nodes as traffic migrates.

sre-jordan: p95 dropped to 1.4s now, p99 4.2s. Queue trending down but not back to baseline yet. Keeping oncall until stable or ticket escalated.

maria-ops: brief rollback plan if model variant introduces regressions: revert flag + route all traffic to fallback pool (cpu fallback) and enable throttling by tenant.

support-lina: customers notified. Two customers (acme-corp, jugger) replied asking for ETA and compensation; CS lead looped in.

eng-tomas: note — autoscaler config has a conservative soft-limit of 12 nodes for this pool. We need to discuss raising soft-limit, but that requires capacity request and infra approval. I'll open a PR to increase soft-limit to 18 for emergency only.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE by maria-ops: mitigation in place (cross-region fallback + quantized variant). Queue reduced to 3,100. Continued monitoring. Link to incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1768000000

sre-jordan: leaving a checklist here before handoff: 1) confirm cloud quota approval (CLD-8421) 2) monitor p99 <5s for 10m 3) verify no client errors increased 4) support followups logged. I'll hand to @maria-ops in 10m if stable.

maria-ops: taking over for next 2 hours. Will keep updates in this thread every 10m or on major changes. :white_check_mark:

sre-jordan: thanks — standing down from bridge in 3m once checks pass. Great work team.

ops-bot: INCIDENT NOTE appended by support-lina: Top customer impact recorded; GEs created for billing outreach.

maria-ops: final note — postmortem required. Initial hypothesis: sudden customer campaign created fanout + autoscaler blocked by cloud quota; long-term recommendations: add autoscaler circuit-breaker, increase soft-limit emergency path, and automate regional overflow routing. I'll file the postmortem template after stabilization.

ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigation stable) at 1768000800. Metrics: queue baseline restored, GPU util back to 70-80%.
